summary: The 8-K filed by Northern States Power Co (a subsidiary of Xcel Energy) reports a non-unanimous settlement in a 2025 Minnesota natural gas rate case, seeking a $38 million revenue increase with a weighted average cost of capital of 7.21%. This is a routine regulatory filing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing updates on ongoing regulatory proceedings with expected MPUC decision in November 2026.
